answer: Duplicate identities fail because the attestation cannot be reused. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to burn a small stake of a scarce resource to mint a unique identity, where the burn is recorded as a crystal-clear on-chain proof tied to a one-time hardware attestation. The cost rises from an ember of stake to a full burn at volume, pushing attacker economics toward their nadir, since forging thousands of identities costs far more than any reward they could extract. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
